title: Tromml proposal content
description: Input for build_proposal.js. Order of `sections` is the order they render. Add or drop sections freely — the structure is a default, not a cage.

eyebrow.description: ALL-CAPS kicker above the title, e.g. 'SIGNAL AUDIT + AI ENABLEMENT'.

summary.description: At-a-glance table. Each item is [label, value]. Typical labels: Client, Primary Contacts, Scope, Engagement, Term, Investment.

type.description: 'section' = heading + optional italic intro + body paragraphs + optional bullets + optional note. 'examples' = the 'What This Looks Like in Practice' block (default labels Signal/Collateral/AI executes, but configurable — see labels/rows). 'investment' = prose + one or more fee tables (last column right-aligned). 'table' = heading + intro + body + one or more left-aligned tables (e.g. a capabilities map) + optional bullets + note.

labels.description: examples type only: override the default labels. Keys: signal, collateral, ai. Use this for non-marketing deals, e.g. {"collateral":"Surfaced","ai":"Action"}.

intro.description: For 'section': italic lead-in under the heading. For 'investment': normal prose paragraph.

note.description: Italic muted note at the end of the block.

rows.description: Alternative to signal/collateral/ai: fully custom [label, text] pairs for this item.

closing.description: examples type only: italic closing line.

title.description: Sub-head above the table, e.g. 'Phase 1: Signal Audit'.

columns.description: Header cells, usually 3. Last column is the fee (right-aligned).

columnWidths.description: Optional DXA widths summing to 9360. Default [2300,5060,2000].

footer.default: Tromml, Inc.  •  201 E Main Street, Durham, NC 27701  •  tromml.com
